Why This Market “Melt-Up” is Making Me Nervous | The Weekly Wrap

Eisman reduces exposure after a rapid technology-led rally, emphasizing speculative positioning, war risk and producer inflation while maintaining his no-recession view. He separates healthier banks from a risky private-credit cycle, prefers network moats in payments, and continues to favor AI infrastructure and Meritage while short FICO. Cisco results support the supplier thesis. His near-term Coinbase profit prediction is ambiguous because GAAP losses persisted while adjusted EBITDA was positive.
